description: lmblender runs lmscript scenes through a standalone CPU Cycles renderer and writes stills, sequences, and exports.
task: Create a polished 3D scene from an empty directory using lmblender v0.3.6. Include a camera, materials, lighting, and a rendered PNG. Add a concrete result check, run the source, and report the files and verification.

examples.description: Layer skin-like translucent shading, a rim light, and a dark studio backdrop.
Show a bouncing sphere at successive positions in a single strobe-style scene.
Build and label a caffeine molecule from spheres, bonds, and color-coded atoms.
Render a glass sphere and lens with reflected caustic light on a floor.
Compare colored walls, a ceiling light, and two objects in a Cornell box.
Build a paired DNA helix with colored rails, rungs, and atom-like details.
Render interlocking gears with a machined metal finish and studio lighting.
Use a window, volumetric haze, and a directional light to reveal visible rays.
Stage a miniature planetary orbit and render one frame of its animation.
Create a translucent salt crystal with faceted geometry and controlled highlights.
Build a ringed planet with layered bands and a dark space background.
Use a low warm sun to cast long shadows across a simple landscape.
